info.title: Awardco API
info.description:
## Overview Awardco uses REST based web services to allow developers to interact with the Awardco platform. In order to use the Awardco API, an API key is needed and must be passed on each call. We require passing the API key as a request header. A key will be provided to approved developers upon request. All API calls must be made using the HTTPS protocol. All responses are in JSON format and include a success field indicating whether the call was successful or not. The categories in the menu outline the individual API calls available to developers.
*** *** *** ## Base URL The base url for all API calls is located at https://​api.awardco.com/api/method. Where “method” is the specific service being called.
*** *** *** ## Authentication All API requests must include a valid API Key provided as a request header. ``` apiKey : 00000000000000000000000000000000 ``` API keys are configured with specific permissions that control access to particular endpoints. When creating an API key, you can assign permissions based on the resources and operations you intend to use. For details on how to create an API key and assign permissions, please refer to our [API Key Management Documentation]. [ API Key Management Documentation ]: https://awardco.my.site.com/Customerhelp/s/article/Managing-API-Keys?language=en_US
*** *** *** ## Timestamps All timestamps are returned in ISO 8601 format. ``` YYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ ```
*** *** *** ## Partnership Integration If you are an Awardco partner, please include the X-Partner-Id header in your requests. Doing so will help us more easily troubleshoot for you and identify clients using your integration. ``` apiKey : 00000000000000000000000000000000 X-Partner-Id : your-partner-id ```

tags.name: Legacy Reports
tags.description:
All legacy reports can return a JSON object or a CSV file. The endpoints below will be using the JSON format. To get the CSV format, simply modify the endpoint path with 'csv' instead of 'json'.
For example, https://api.awardco.com/api/reports/recognition-details/csv.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description:
## Webhook Registration Looking to setup webhooks? Check out this [support documentation.](https://awardco.my.site.com/Customerhelp/s/article/Creating-Webhooks?language=en_US) ## Webhook Headers Webhook endpoints should use HTTPS and expect to receive POST requests with the following headers: ```json { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Awardco-Signature": "v5233fg2fsdfdTFdwqBx4vOntjJdbgdfgR=", "Awardco-Timestamp": "1708551969" } ``` *** ## Webhook Verification **Awardco uses HMAC-SHA256 webhook verification. The following are steps you can use to verify a webhook using the verification header:** 1. **Extract the signature from the header.** The `Awardco-Signature` header was created by hashing the webhook's body with the webhook's secret before sending the request. You can verify the request is from Awardco by generating that same signature with your secret. 2. **Extract the timestamp from the header.** The `Awardco-Timestamp` is when the request was sent. You can verify that the request is not a replay attack by checking if the unix timestamp is within an acceptable time limit. Usually within 300 seconds or five minutes should be sufficient. Most events will also contain a unique id for the event, so you can save that event id and verify that this request does not have the same id as a previous request. 3. **Generate the webhook signature.** Using the webhook secret, hash the webhook's body and the `Awardco-Timestamp` together in the form `{timestamp}.{body}` to generate the same webhook signature as the `Awardco-Signature`. Do not change the body in any way before verifying. The signature is sensitive to any changes. If the signature you generate does not match the `Awardco-Signature` reject the request. 4. **Handle the request and return a 200.** If the signature is valid, handle the event and return a 200 within 3 seconds. If we don't receive a 200 within 3 seconds, we will email the error email recipients. **Event delivery and ordering** Some events will be sent out of order potentially.
*** ## Webhook Payload Structure #### Common fields Each webhook event, regardless of type, contains the following fields in the response body: * `companyId` (integer): Unique id for a company. * `companyName` (string): The company Display Name. * `companyUrl` (string): The company's unique base url Example - "https://[subdomain].awardco.com".

post.description:
*The primary request from the API that will provide the specified report data in CSV or JSON format.*

For this API, you must provide the report name you wish to pull data from. Additionally, you can specify filters and data points required.
These filters and data points are different depending on the name of the report. Please refer to the [ report-info ] endpoint for instructions on how to discover these programmatically.

If you are **only** using strings or boolean they may be used in the query params instead of the body.

```
POST https://api.awardco.com/api/report-api?reportName=Recognition Details&returnType=json&startDate=1/1/2022&endDate=4/20/2022
```

[ report-info ]: /api-v2-beta#tag/reports/GET/report-info

reportName.description:
The name of the matching report you wish to pull data from.
Currently supported reports are:
- Recognition Details
- Points Redeemed
- Point Transactions
- Point Budgets
- Money Spent
- Redemption Account
- Money Deposited
- Recognition Status
- Users
- Login
- Client Fulfillment
- Funding Reconciliation
- Recognition Program Utilization
- User Point Balance
- MemoryBook Usage
- Redemption Point Source (FIFO)

returnType.description:
The return format to provide all results in.
Currently supported options are:
  - csv
  - json

timeRangeOption.description:
The time range you wish to pull data for.
If specified, it will override values provided by startDate and endDate.
Currently supported time ranges are:
- This Week
- This Month
- This Quarter
- This Year
- Last Week
- Last Month
- Last Quarter
- Last Year
- All Time
- Custom
- This Period (Default - Only for Recognition Program Utilization Report)
- Last Period (Only for Recognition Program Utilization Report)

\* When pulling data for the MemoryBook Usage Report for a timeframe that is inclusive of today, the report will also return the next 35 days of queued MemoryBooks and their associated data.

startDate.default: Date of first record for this company
startDate.description:
The date from when records should begin.
This is defined in UTC time and ISO-86601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).
This is not supported for the Recognition Program Utilization Report.

endDate.description:
The date when records should end.
This is defined in UTC time and ISO-86601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).
This is not supported for the Recognition Program Utilization Report.

includeRecordCount.description:
When specified a value of 'Record-Count' will be added to the headers of the response.
This value will contain the total number of records that were returned by the API.
This can be used for data integrity checking.

**Note:** Enabling the includeRecordCount option will increase the execution time of the report. It should not be used unless needed for data checking.

dataFilters.description:
A JSON Object that determines which filters to apply on the whole dataset in order to return limited scopes of data.
These filters are based on standard values as well as metadata values provided in your unique instance of the Awardco Platform.

If not defined, no filtering will be applied.

All keys and values are case sensitive.
Additionally all values will be matched explicitly - if there is more than one value with the same name in the defined dataset and scope all will be returned.

It is also possible to provide a JSON null value to match any records with no data for that filter.

contentColumns.description:
An array of data points/csv columns to return for the matching records.
These columns are based on standard values as well as metadata values provided in your unique instance of the Awardco Platform.

If not defined, all possible columns will be returned.

All column names are case sensitive.

Columns will always return in the order they are defined. If no columns are defined, there is no guarantee that all columns will remain in the same order in the future  .

post.description: Creates a recognition for specified users.

recipients.description:
A list of employeeIds, emails, or usernames.
All recipients have to be eligible to be recognized in the associated recognition program.
At least one is required, and if duplicate users are found or too many recipients are specified, an error will be returned.

tagNames.description:
A list of tags to attach to the recognition.
If any of the tags are not found, or the tags are not eligible to be used with the associated Recognition Program, an error will be returned

recognitionProgramId.description:
Not required if recognitionProgramId is specified.

The id of the recognition program.
If the recognition program is archived or the recognition program is not found, an error will be returned.
The recognition program settings will determine recognition limits and notification settings.

recognitionProgramName.description:
The name of the recognition program.
If the recognition program is archived, multiple are found with the same name, or the recognition program is not found, an error will be returned. 
The recognition program settings will determine recognition limits and notification settings.

giver.description:
The giver for the recognition.
The giver has to be eligible to recognize in the associated recognition program.
If giver is null or an empty string, the company recognition bot will be used

note.description: A short note describing the reason the user is receiving the recognition.

budgetName.description:
Required if amount is greater than 0 and the recognition program uses allowable access budgets.

If the recognition program uses central budgets, or recipient based budgets, this field is ignored and the budget used will be based on the recognition program settings.
If the recognition program uses allowable access budgets, then budgetName is required, and the budget specified has to be allowed in the recognition program and the giver must have access to that budget.
If the budget is not allowed, or is archived an error is returned.

amount.description:
The cash value of the recognition in currency.
If the recognition program does not allow custom point amounts, then the amount must be one of the presets for the recognition program.

isPublic.description:
Whether or not the recognition is public.
If the associated recognition program only allows private recognitions, and isPublic is true, an error is returned.
If the recognition is private and there is more than one recipient, the recognition will appear as an individual recognition in the feed.
If the recognition is public and there is more than one recipient, the recognition will appear as a group recognition in the feed.
If the recognition is public, and a recipient is opted out of public recognitions, it will send them a private recognition.

title.description:
A new question type that allows users to give the recognition a headline. 
The title response could have a maximum of 50 characters and can be submitted only when the recognition program has the title question enabled.

The name of the active budget to use for rewarding.
If the giver user has access to only one active budget, the recognition will come from that budget regardless of the budgetName given.
If the giver user has access to more than one active budget, the budgetName will be used to find all active budgets with that name and will filter that list to only budgets to which the user has access or which have no metadata, user, or group access rules.
Group budgets and archived budgets cannot be used.

post.description:
The Bulk Reward endpoint is deprecated and will be disabled July 1, 2026.

Please begin transitioning to the 'Bulk Recognize' endpoint below, which supports more robust validation, respects global receiving limits, and avoids the concurrency issues present in Bulk Reward.

Bulk Reward does not respect global receiving limits.
If you would like to respect global receiving limits, it is recommended to use the /api/recognize endpoint.

Bulk Reward will succeed only if all recognitions are processed successfully.
Bulk Reward can experience concurrency issues if you recognize a lot of people and use a budget that is being used for other recognitions.
Avoid using a Bulk Reward budget for multiple programs.

file.description:
The csv file that contains the recognition information. See below for more information on the CSV format.

Download the csv template: <ins>[ bulk-reward.csv ]<ins>

[bulk-reward.csv]: api/bulk-reward/template

**CSV Parameters:**
- **From User (required):**
    The employee id or email of the giver.
- **To User (required):**
    The employee id or email of the reward recipient.
- **Note (required):**
    A short note describing the reason the user is receiving the award.
- **Program Name (required):**
    The name of the recognition program to use for this reward.
    Note that all rewards submitted through this API will still be subject to all program settings including eligibility limits, nomination limits, approvals, etc.
    Also note that the recognition program can only have 1 question.
- **Tags:**
    Semicolon delimited list of tags to attach to the reward.
- **Amount:**
    How much the award is worth.
    If the recognition program allows custom amounts and amounts are being displayed as points, then amount should be in points NOT currency.
    If the recognition program allows custom amounts and point display is turned OFF but currency display is turned ON, then amount should be in the giver's country's currency NOT points.
    Otherwise, amount should be provided in the company's currency NOT points.
- **Budget Name:**
    The name of the budget to use for rewarding. Required if the from user has more than one budget assigned to them.
- **Public/Private:**
    Determines whether the recognition will be public or private.
    Valid values are "public" and "private".
    If left blank and the recognition program allows public recognitions, the recognition will be public.
    Otherwise if left blank the recognition will be private.

The csv file that contains the recognition information. See below for more information on the CSV format.

Download the csv template: <ins>[ bulk-recognize.csv ]<ins>

[bulk-recognize.csv]: api/bulk-recognize/template

**CSV Parameters:**
- **Recognition Date (ISO 8601) (required):**
    The date that the recognition will be processed in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.FFFK).
    For example, 2023-03-20, 2023-03-20T19:58:00+00:00, or 2023-03-20T19:58:00Z
- **From User (required):**
    The employee id or email of the giver.
- **To User (required):**
    The employee id or email of the reward recipient.
- **Note (required):**
    The note that is attached to the recognition.
- **Tags:**
    Semicolon delimited list of tags to attach to the reward.
- **Year:**
    The "Year" column was typically used for anniversary years for manual service award uploads.
- **Amount (Currency):**
   The cash value of the recognition in the company's base currency.
- **Budget Name (required if Amount is greater than 0):**
    The name of the budget from which we will draw the points for the recognition.
- **Public/Private (required):**
    "Public" if the recognition should be visible to people other than the recipient and giver. "Private" if the recognition should only be visible to the recipient and giver.
- **Email template:**
    The name of the email template to use to send an email notification to the recipient.
- **Program Name:**
    The program name or id of the recognition program used for the recognition.
    The program is useful for custom or limited redemption options and for reporting purposes.
- **Notify Manager (Employee Id/Email):**
    The employee id or email of the manager to notify of the recognition.
- **Notify Date (ISO 8601) (required if notify Manager is not empty):**
    The date to notify the manager.
- **Notify Email Template (required if notify Manager is not empty):**
    The name of the email template used to notify the manager.

get.description:
Get recognitions with the ability to filter recognitions to only recognitions that match the provided metadata filters.

```
Example:
GET https://api.awardco.com/api/v1/custom-feed?page=1&limit=100&metadataFilter=["Product","Engineering"]
```
### Tips:
We recommend calling the API every five minutes to check for new recognitions for each of the respective metadata filters.

If the metadata field that is used as a filter or the values are archived, a warning email will be sent to the company's admins. New recognitions will not show for the archived fields or values.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page of the custom feed. The max value is 100,000.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of recognitions in the custom feed to return (max 1000)

parameters.name: metadataFilter
parameters.description:
By default, the custom feed returns all public recognitions.

You may specify metadata values to filter by using a string JSON array.
* metadataFilter=["Product","Engineering"]
* Escape any double quotes inside a metadata value. For example: "Manager \\"East Coast\\" Operations"
* If the provided JSON array is not valid, a 400 error will be thrown

archive.description:
True = Any user previously in the system that is not on the file being imported will be assigned archive status.

False = Users will not be archived

emailOverride.description:
True = The email in the file is treated as correct and any value will override an existing value.

False = The email in the system is treated as correct. Emails will be added to users with blank values, but no emails will be overridden.

languageOverride.description:
True = The language in the file is treated as correct and any value will override an existing value.

False = The language in the system is treated as correct. Language will be added to users with blank values, but no language will be overridden.

hireDateOverride.description:
True = The hire date in the file is treated as correct and any value will override an existing value.

False = The hire date in the system is treated as correct. Hire dates will be added to users with blank values, but no hire dates will be overridden.

passwordOverride.description:
all = The password in the file is treated as correct and any value will override an existing value.

neverloggedin = If a user has logged in, the password in the system is treated as correct. For users who have never logged in, the password in the file is treated as correct and any value will override an existing value.

no = The password in the system is treated as correct. Passwords will be added to users with blank values, but no passwords will be overridden.

addPhoneNumberPlusSign.description:
True = Add a plus sign in front of phone number data of the phoneNumber column.

False = Keep phoneNumber column as it is in the import data.

doNotArchive.description: Comma-separated string of employeeIds who are not in this file, but shall remain in the system. (e.g. 1,12,27492).

delimiter.description: The delimiter used when not using a comma delimited format (e.g. | or \t)

headerMappings.description:
List any headers that do not conform to the expected standard names to map them into the correct fields.
Whitespace and casing does not have to match.

Format: Field in the file:Field it should map to, Another field in the file: Field it should map to (e.g. Employee Number: Employee ID, FName: First Name).

valueMappings.description:
List any values that do not conform to the expected standard values to map them into the correct fields.
Match the text found in the file perfectly (cases and spaces).
This only applies to values in the the Country Code (Iso 2 Format) and Language columns.

Format: Field in the file: Field it should map to, Another field in the file: Field it should map to (e.g. United Kingdom: GB, English: en).

metadataHeaders.description: Comma-separated string of any headers that do not conform to the expected metadata import format (#header) to map them in as metadata

metadataFilters.description: List any metadata names and values to filter out users by metadata from the import Format: MetadataName:[MetadataValue1,MetadataValue2]

approverMappings.description: A comma separated string of rule mappings to be updated Format: CSVHeaderTitle:ApprovalOverrideRuleId.

privateMetadataHeaders.description: Comma-separated string of any headers that do not conform to the expected private metadata import format (^header) to map them in as private metadata.

post.description:
## Description These webhook events are sent when recognitions are completed and make it through the approval process. If recognitions are edited or deleted, no event will be triggered. If you are integrating webhooks for multiple clients, you can use the companyId or companyUrl to uniquely identify the client.
***
Example Payload ```json { "companyId": 1, "companyName": "Awardco", "companyUrl": "https://aco.awardco.com", "recognitionId": 124524356, "programName": "The Awardco Way", "type": "regular", "completedDateTime": "2024-02-22 15:40:42.860", "note": "You are doing great work. Keep it up!", "mediaUrl": "https://res.cloudinary.com/awardco/image/upload/c_limit,h_375,w_750/v1/recognition-programs/lr4awegpx2g6a98x1dhq", "recognitionUrl": "https://aco.awardco.com/feed/recognition/41960534", "hashtags": ["#teamwork", "#grit", "#level-up"], "tags": ["Teamwork", "Grit", "Level Up"], "isPrivate": true, "monetaryInfo": { "amount": 1, "points": 1, "currencyCode": "USD", "budgetName": "Main Budget", "taxable": true }, "giver": { "fullDisplayName": "John Smith", "firstName": "John", "firstDisplayName": null, "lastName": "Smith", "employeeId": "5232312", "email": "john.smith@awardco.com", "username": "john.smith", "avatarUrl": "https://res.cloudinary.com/awardco/image/upload/h_80/v1/avatars/biyeybmta7ibv1qk7jzy", "countryCode": "US", "metadata": { "jobTitle": "Software Engineer" } }, "recipients": [ { "fullDisplayName": "Jane Doe", "firstName": "Jane", "firstDisplayName": "Jane", "lastName": "Doe", "employeeId": "6342312", "email": "jane.doe@awardco.com", "username": null, "avatarUrl": "https://res.cloudinary.com/awardco/image/upload/h_80/v1/avatars/biyeybmta7ibv1qk7jzy", "receivesPrivateRecognitions": true, "countryCode": "MX", "metadata": { "jobTitle": "Product Manager" } } ] } ```

companyUrl.description: The company's unique base url Example - "https://[subdomain].awardco.com".

recognitionId.description: The unique id for this recognition event.

programName.description: The recognition program for the recognition.

type.description: The type of recognition. One of the following values - regular, card, survey, earn, birthday, service-award, onboarding, one-time-memory-book, queued-recognition.

completedDateTime.description: (UTC time zone) The time when the recognition was completed.

note.description: The note given with the recognition.

mediaUrl.description: The url for the media attached to the recognition.

recognitionUrl.description: A url that links directly to the recognition in Awardco.

hashtags.description: Will be empty if no hashtags were used.

tags.description: Will be empty if no tags were used.

monetaryInfo.description: Information about the monetary value of the recognition.

amount.description: The amount in the company's currency given with the recognition. Whole numbers only, no cents.

points.description: The points given. Some companies have point multipliers, so the amount may be different from the points.

currencyCode.description: The currency code used for the company's monetary recognitions.

budgetName.description: The name of the budget from which the funds for the recognition were taken. Will be null if the amount is 0.

taxable.description: The taxability of the budget. Some recognitions are not considered taxable. Will be null if the amount is 0.

fullDisplayName.description: The user's full name like John Smith.

avatarUrl.description: The url to the user's profile picture.

receivesPrivateRecognitions.description: Recognition recipients can choose to receive only private recognitions if they opt into it and the company allows it. To honor their choice, you may want to exclude them from any public displays. This will not be present on the giver.

countryCode.description: Country code for the user like "US".

metadata.description: Each key in the dictionary is a metadata field and every value is its corresponding metadata value, which can be null. Dictionary of strings to strings.

recipients.description: Will always have at least one recipient.
